text: Architecture is an interdisciplinary subject that studies architectural design, spatial planning, construction technology and architectural culture. It integrates artistic aesthetics, engineering technology and humanities and social sciences, aiming to cultivate professional talents with innovative capabilities in architectural design, practical technical skills and a sense of social responsibility. This major emphasizes the integration of theory and practice, covering fields such as architectural design, urban planning, heritage protection, and sustainable architecture. It serves as a bridge connecting the humanities and arts with engineering technology.
